results.description:
You didn't plan to become a carer. You just loved someone.

Now you're the one holding the appointment letter, the medication list, and the group chat nobody answers.

You're the one calling to check whether anyone visited. The one who knows what three different people promised to do this week.

There are days it feels like too much. Days when you wish someone else would step up, even for an hour. That feeling is not a failure. It's what happens when one person carries more than one person should.

The hardest part is not the doing. It is the knowing: being the one who always holds the full picture, because it lives only in your head.

KinCarer puts that picture somewhere the whole care circle can see it.

One shared schedule for tasks, visits and appointments. Check-ins so everyone knows someone arrived, without anyone having to phone. A chat beside the schedule, where any message can become a task in two taps. Routines and medication notes, so whoever visits next knows what's needed. Care Files for the documents that matter, somewhere the whole circle can find them.

When the picture is shared, the load is shared. Not just the doing, but the knowing.

WHO KINCARER IS FOR
Families looking after an elderly parent.
Brothers and sisters sharing the care from different towns.
Partners caring for someone with dementia or a long-term condition.
Families caring alongside paid carers or a care agency.
Anyone who has become the one who holds the full picture.

SHARED SCHEDULE
Add tasks, visits, appointments and reminders so everyone in the care circle can see what needs doing, who is doing it, and what has already happened.

CHECK-INS
Let the care circle know when someone has arrived at the care location. Turn on automatic check-ins and it takes one tap when a phone notices the arrival. KinCarer does not show live movement.

CIRCLE CHAT
Family and carers talk beside the schedule, not in another app. Anything decided in the chat can become a task or appointment in two taps, so nothing important gets buried.

ROUTINES AND MEDICATION
Keep daily routines, medication notes and care preferences together, so the next person helping knows what's needed.

HANDOVER NOTES
Leave an update after visits, appointments or changes so everyone stays in the loop without repeating the same messages.

CARE FILES
Store GP letters, care plans, photos and other documents in one place, so your care circle can find what matters when they need it.

CLARA AI ASSISTANT
Ask Clara what happened today, who checked in, or what is still waiting for someone. Clara answers only from what your circle has written down. Clara is optional and does not give medical advice.

CARE CIRCLE
Invite family members, friends, neighbours or paid carers. Roles and permissions help make sure people see the right information for how they are helping.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION FOR THE WHOLE CIRCLE
Family+ is one plan for the whole care circle, paid monthly or yearly, with 14 days free on the yearly plan. One subscription covers everyone: there is no member limit, and everyone you invite joins free. If Family+ ends, the circle becomes read-only until someone renews. Nothing is deleted.

KinCarer does not replace the love, judgement or care you already give. It helps you organise it, share it and feel less alone carrying it.

Download KinCarer and share the load.

Important: KinCarer is a family care coordination and planning app. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency response, safeguarding services or professional care services. Clara AI provides organisational support only and should not replace advice from qualified professionals.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your App Store settings.

Privacy Policy: https://kincarer.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

results.description:
Caring for a parent between several people shouldn't depend on a group chat nobody reads in time.

TurnCrew brings everything a family needs to share the care of an elderly or dependent loved one into one shared circle — so everyone knows who's on duty, which doses are done and what's still pending.

TODAY, AT A GLANCE
One screen with who's on duty right now, how many doses are done, the next appointment and a time-ordered plan for the day. Mark a dose as taken with one tap.

SHIFTS
Organize visits, nights, transport, errands or check-in calls. List or month view, reminders before each shift and export to your iPhone Calendar.

MEDICATION
Grouped by morning, midday, evening and night, with real confirmation states: taken, delayed, skipped, refused, out of stock or cancelled by a professional. Refill alerts before a medication runs out.

CARE BALANCE
See how the care is really shared across the family over the last 7 days — and get a gentle nudge when one person is carrying most of the load.

HANDOFFS
Leave a clear note for the next caregiver, with an on-device summary of the day.

EXPENSES
Log shared costs, scan receipts and see instantly who owes whom.

CIRCLE & EMERGENCY
Invite your family with a real iCloud share, keep emergency information, allergies and important documents in one place.

WIDGETS, SIRI & LIVE ACTIVITIES
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity while a shift is running, and Siri shortcuts to mark a dose or add an expense.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your data lives in your own iCloud, shared only with the people you invite. TurnCrew has no server of its own and never sells your data. Lock the app with Face ID.

Free, always: invite your family with iCloud, handoffs with read receipts, up to 10 shifts, 6 members and 3 medications. TurnCrew Premium (1-week free trial) adds unlimited shifts, more than one person and family circle, full history, receipt and medication-box scanning, on-device AI handoff summaries and CSV export.

NOTES

results.description:
Transcribe turns speech to text and shows live subtitles for face-to-face conversations. Read what someone says in large text on your iPhone. Built for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, and for families looking for a way to communicate with a parent who has hearing loss.

LIVE TRANSCRIPTION AND DICTATION
Follow conversations at home, at a medical appointment or at a service counter. Use voice dictation to turn spoken words into text, and save a conversation transcript as a note to read later. Adjust the font size to make reading easier.

TYPE A REPLY OR HAVE IT SPOKEN
Write your response on the keyboard and show it to the other person, or have the app read your message aloud. Keep a conversation going when listening is difficult.

SOUND ALERTS AND APPLE WATCH
Receive vibration alerts for selected sounds, including a doorbell, knocking, a baby crying or a dog barking. Read captions and receive alerts on an Apple Watch paired with your iPhone.

DOES SPEECH TO TEXT WORK OFFLINE?
Transcribe supports speech recognition in more than 60 languages. Offline recognition is available for selected languages and compatible devices; it is not available for every language.

Choose the speaker's language and start recognition. A subscription is required. A free trial is available under the offer's eligibility conditions. See the app for pricing and renewal terms.

Subscription: £3.99 per month or £37.99 per year in the United Kingdom. The price where you are is shown in the app before you subscribe.

results.description:
I'm Alive is a simple daily check-in for people who live on their own. Once a day, at a time you choose, tap "I'm Okay". If you miss it, you're reminded first, and if you still don't respond, the person you chose is alerted.

Made for:
• People who live independently and want to keep it that way
• Adult children checking on a parent without calling every day
• Solo travellers

How it works:
• Pick your check-in time
• Tap once in the app or from your Home Screen widget
• Miss it, and you're reminded, then your contact is alerted
• Check in late and they're told you're OK
• Your contact doesn't need the app

Running late? Contacts who use the app can see your recent phone activity, like when you opened the app or unplugged your phone, for peace of mind. It's for reference only: it never counts as a check-in and never stops an alert.

Free: daily check-in, 1 contact, reminders, and 1 missed check-in alert a month by email.

Paid plans add up to 10 contacts, text alerts (where available), extra check-in times, SOS, fall detection (beta), journey check-ins and an AI voice check-in call. Lifetime is a one-time purchase.

No wearable, no cameras, no constant location tracking. We don't sell your data.

I'm Alive is not a medical device or emergency service and does not contact emergency services for you.

results.description:
Caring for someone you love, together with your family? With CareWall everyone knows what is going on and who does what, without endless messages and loose lists.

ONE CARE CIRCLE, EVERYONE IN THE LOOP
Create a care circle for your mother, father, grandma or grandpa and invite the family. Everyone sees the same: what happens today, what still needs doing and how things are going.

WHO DOES WHAT? EVERYONE KNOWS

FOR CARE PROFESSIONALS

results.description:
Carely helps your loved one take their medication on time - and gives you the peace of mind that everything's on track.

Carely connects two people in one simple app: an elderly parent who gets gentle medication reminders, and a carer who can see whether each dose was taken - without the constant phone calls and checking in.

FOR YOUR PARENT - simple from the very first tap
- Medication reminders, right on schedule
- One tap to confirm, snooze or skip a dose
- Large buttons and a clear screen
- No sign-up, no login, no passwords
- Low-stock and expiry alerts so refills never slip

FOR THE CARER - calm instead of worry
- An instant alert the moment a dose is missed
- A full dose history - what was taken, and when
- Daily and weekly adherence at a glance
- A read-only view of all their medication and dosage
- Connect with a single code, in seconds

MADE FOR REAL FAMILIES
Whether you're caring for an elderly parent, supporting someone living with dementia, or simply helping a loved one stay on top of their medicines - Carely keeps everyone gently in the loop.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your parent's account is anonymous - no email, no personal details required. Data is encrypted, and a carer only ever sees the information of the person they're connected to.

Carely is for families who want to stay close without being intrusive. You stay informed; they stay independent.

Download Carely and make sure no dose is ever forgotten.

Carely is a tool to support medication routines - it is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Always consult a doctor or pharmacist about your health and medicines.

Your parents are ageing. Caring for them should not cost you your own life.

HoldingHands is where a family keeps one shared picture of how Mum and Dad are doing, so the work stops living inside one person's head and one group chat.

WHAT IT DOES EVERY DAY

The morning brief. One message at 7: what medicine was taken yesterday, what is happening today, who is on duty. A quiet day is reported as a quiet day.

Medicines. Every dose, for both parents, with the name of whoever gave it. One tap to confirm. If a dose is missed, the person responsible hears about it first, and you hear about it next.

Appointments. Photograph the clinic letter and the app fills in the date, the department and the fasting note, then asks who is bringing them.

The roster. Duties claimed by name, gaps said out loud, and an honest four week picture of who has been carrying what. It ends the "why is it always me" argument with facts instead of feelings.

Your helper. Her own screen: today's list, big buttons, one tap each, and a photo when something is not clear. She is a professional in the circle, not staff under watch.

Your parent's own screen. Elder Mode has five giant buttons, Chinese first, and what they tap shows up in the family record as theirs. Independence is the point.

The emergency card. Conditions, medicines, allergies, clinic, the people to call. Two taps, works with no signal, prints to wallet size.

Your words. What to say when you have to take the car keys away, hire a helper, split the costs with a brother who does nothing, or sit at a bedside. In English and in Chinese.

The money. Who paid what, tallied every month, split between siblings without screenshots in the chat.

And someone watching how you are doing. Two minutes on a Monday. If your tank is running low, HoldingHands hands one of your duties to someone else and writes the message for you.

WHAT IT WILL NEVER DO

It does not give medical, money or legal advice, and it is not built to. It records and it reminds. Your doctor and your pharmacist advise, and HoldingHands prints them a clean medicine list so every visit starts with the full picture instead of a guess.

BUILT FOR FAMILIES HERE

Care in Singapore and across Asia works differently, and the app is shaped around it: the helper has her own role, Chinese runs through the whole app, both your parents and your in-laws sit in one circle, siblings split the costs, and the sibling overseas gets the picture without calling every Sunday.

WHO SEES WHAT

Every role sees only what it should. A helper never sees documents or money. A doctor sees a consented, read-only summary. The owner can see who looked at what and when. Nothing is sold, rented or shared outside your family, ever. You can download everything and delete everything from inside the app, at any time, without asking anyone.

HoldingHands is a product of LEANERTOGETHER PTE. LTD., Singapore.

results.description:
Is today going to plan? And if it isn't, who needs to know?

InHomeLog is a caregiver organizer for in-home care. The daily checklist, calendar, supplies, medications, preferences and caregiver messages live in one shared care record, so in-home caregivers see exactly what's needed and you can see it got done, whether you're in the next room or across the country.

Made for family caregivers looking after an aging parent, a spouse or another loved one at home, and for the in-home caregivers who help them.

BUILT BY A FAMILY CAREGIVER
InHomeLog started at a kitchen table, not a boardroom. Our founder spent years caring for his aging parents at home: coordinating in-home caregivers, tracking medications and appointments, keeping the cupboards stocked, and remembering which caregiver had been told what. The details lived in texts, sticky notes and his own memory, and every gap became a missed dose, a duplicated errand or an anxious call at work. InHomeLog is the tool he wished he'd had.

THREE PEOPLE, ONE CARE RECORD
Care manager: plans the in-home care and checks in. Often an adult child or spouse, sometimes a professional care coordinator.
Care recipient: the person cared for at home, such as an elderly parent. Their routine, needs and supplies live in one place.
Caregiver: gives the care in the home, sees today's tasks and reports back.

HOW IT WORKS
Set up: Add the person you care for, with their routine, medications, allergies, likes and dislikes, and the supplies kept in the home.
Invite: Add in-home caregivers. They sign in with their own account, or enter a personal access code on a device you provide.
Care: Caregivers work through today's checklist, add a photo or note, count supplies and flag anything unusual.
Stay informed: From anywhere, see what's done, what's late and what needs your attention.

WHAT'S IN A CARE RECORD
Checklist: Daily caregiver tasks, with times and who does them.
Calendar: Appointments, caregiver visits and events.
Supplies: What's on the shelf and what's running low.
Preferences & restrictions: Food, routines, allergies and diet rules.
Medications: What to take, and when.
Messages: Health notes and supply requests, sent straight to you.

FOR EVERY KIND OF IN-HOME CARE
Caring on your own: keep the checklist and supplies straight, and add caregivers when you need help.
Leading a care team: coordinate several in-home caregivers and care recipients in one overview.
A caregiver with a code: no account needed. Enter your code and see today's tasks.

IN EACH CAREGIVER'S OWN LANGUAGE
InHomeLog is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean, so every caregiver can use it in the language they know best.

FEWER GAPS, LESS WORRY
No more "did anyone give Mom her pills?"
No more duplicate grocery runs or empty cupboards
No more repeating instructions to every new caregiver

START FREE
The free plan covers one person, with a daily checklist, preferences and supplies. Upgrade as your care needs grow.

Download In Home Log and give everyone on the in-home care team one clear picture of the day.

results.description:
Strider helps you keep your day on track and stay independent — and gives your family a calm, reassuring window into how you're doing.

Built first for older and mobility-impaired adults: large buttons, plain words, and gentle, forgiving steps throughout.

WHAT STRIDER DOES
- Simple daily check-ins — got out, meals, hydration, up-and-about, mood, and an "I'm OK" button
- Medication reminders you confirm in one tap, with refill reminders and a kind adherence streak

- Weather-aware nudges to get out when the day suits
- Important contacts with a fast emergency view
- A read-only family view — your loved ones see gentle weekly trends, framed as conversation starters. Amber at most, never a red alarm. You choose what's shared, and can pause it any time.

CALM BY DESIGN
Strider is not a monitoring or tracking app. Family see trends, not your location. It's designed to be welcomed, not imposed.

FREE TRIAL, THEN SUBSCRIPTION
Try the whole of Strider free for 14 days — every feature, no limits. After the trial it's £4.99/month or £39.99/year, and you can cancel any time. No adverts, and we never sell your data.

Strider is not a medical device or emergency service. In an emergency, always call 999.

results.description:
Caring for someone you love should never feel lonely.

When someone you love needs more support, the family around them is often far apart. Different towns. Different schedules. The quiet worry of not being there. WarmNote gives your family one warm, private place to stay close, so no one carries it alone.

For the person at the heart of it all
Their screen is calm and simple. Big buttons. Kind words. One gentle thing at a time. With a single tap they can share how they are feeling today. Or they can just speak, and WarmNote writes it down for them. No typing. No fuss. Just their voice, heard.

For the family who cannot always be there
You see the small moments as they happen. A photo from this morning. A note that lunch went down well. How mum slept last night. The little things that tell you she is okay, even from far away.

So nothing is ever missed
Medicines, appointments and doctor visits all live in one place. Everyone can see what has been done and what is coming up. That quiet worry of "did someone remember?" finally settles.

Safe, and only for your family
Your circle is invite only. What you share stays between the people you trust. Your information is never sold and never used for advertising. Carers see only what they need to help, and your family's private notes stay in the family.

Care feels lighter when you carry it together.
That is what WarmNote is for.

WarmNote is free for a circle of up to 2 people.
Family plan: up to 6 members.
Extended plan: up to 15 members.

Care Daily Family is the app for relatives and friends of someone who receives home care from a care provider that uses Care Daily. It shows you the care your loved one receives – who visited, when, and how they are – so you can stay close even when you can't be there.

VISITS AND CARE NOTES
• See today's and upcoming visits, and which carer is coming
• Read what happened at each visit, in the carers' own notes
• Look back over the daily care log

HEALTH AND WELLBEING
• Check the medication record – what was given and when
• Follow how your loved one has been with wellbeing updates
• Read the care plan and see who is in the care team

STAY IN TOUCH

• Get notified about new messages and important alerts

PRIVATE AND SECURE
